# The public grid cellEditing example has no e2e witness

## Context

Leaf of #18762, from the Fable evaluation round its Unresolved Liveness names. The epic's delivered coverage — `test/playwright/component/grid/CellEditing.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` — drives one synthetic fixture, `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-cell-editing`, whose only editor is the default text field. `examples/grid/cellEditing`, the app a reader opens to try cell editing, is booted by one spec (`component/grid/ColumnRendererScope.spec.mjs`) that proves it renders rows; nothing edits a cell in it.

## The Problem

Driving the example by real pointer and keyboard at `dev@3f859a4803` found the text and number editors completing the whole loop and both picker editors broken (filed beside this leaf: the picker trigger ending the edit, and ComboBox on a bound store). None of it could have reddened CI: no arm opens a non-text editor, and no arm touches the public example. D#17832's evidence bar assigns exactly this to public proof: "Exercise real pointer and keyboard input, then assert both DOM focus and App-Worker truth" on the existing example.

## The Architectural Reality

- `examples/grid/cellEditing/MainContainer.mjs` — four editable columns: text (`firstname`, `lastname`), `NumberField` (`randomNumber`, step 5, 0–100), `DateField` (`randomDate`), `CountryField` with `bind: {store: 'stores.countries'}`; `githubId` is `editable: false`; the toolbar swaps the selection model and disables the plugin.
- `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs` — `test/playwright/e2e/grid` is in `RUN_PATHS` as a directory, and the e2e config deselects any spec whose source contains `neuralLink`, so a Brain-free spec in that folder executes in CI.
- App-Worker truth without the Brain: `Neo.worker.App.getConfigs`, the read `CellEditingPooling.spec.mjs` already uses.

## The Fix

One Brain-free spec, `test/playwright/e2e/grid/CellEditingExample.spec.mjs`, on the public example, real pointer and keys only, asserting DOM focus and the record:

- text: double-click, type, Enter → the record and the cell carry the value, focus is on `grid.View`; Enter and F2 on the selected cell activate too;
- number: the spin trigger and ArrowUp step by 5 inside one session, Enter commits (the value's type is not asserted: the DOM cannot tell `100` from `'100'` without the Brain);
- Escape discards the draft and the record is unchanged;
- a click on another cell commits the draft and selects that cell;
- `githubId` refuses every activation gesture before any editor exists;
- the plugin's `disabled` checkbox stops activation and re-enables it.

The date-picker and combo arms land with their defect leaves, in this spec.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The spec above exists, runs in the CI e2e tier, and is green on `dev`.
- [ ] Each arm is killed by one named mutation of `src/grid/plugin/CellEditing.mjs` — or, for focus return, of `component.Base#destroy`, which owns it — recorded in the PR: no arm passes against an engine that cannot commit, cancel, refuse or hand focus back.
- [ ] No correctness sleeps; every wait is a polled condition.
- [ ] 20 consecutive local runs green before the PR opens.

## Out of Scope

Picker and combo editor arms (their own leaves) · Tab traversal and select-on-activation (interaction-contract scope, unfiled) · high-cardinality sort/filter/locked arms · the Grids guide · the Table control.

## Avoided Traps

- **A Neural Link whitebox spec:** green on a Brain seat, deselected in CI — the trap the epic already names.
- **Arms asserting today's picker behaviour:** that would ossify two defects as contract.
